additional_info.subject: 0430459 - ID0430459-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R4 312555359/102] TPE Problem CRM:00568000293
additional_info.body:
Bonjour,
Le problème n'est pas lié au TPE mais à la connection OCPP qui n'est fonctionnelle. Je n'ai pas relevé de flag ni de logs dans le SCB qui indique que le TPE est non fonctionnel.
Par contre la carte SIM du routeur OCPP semble mal insérée ce qui explique pourquoi le routeur n'est pas connecté au backend et que la transaction TPE ne peut se faire puisque la communication vers le serveur bancaire passe par le routeur OCPP du chargeur .
Par conséquent, je vous invite a envoyer quelqu'un sur site afin de reinsérer proprement la carte et SIM et une fois la connection OCPP ok, relancer une transaction par TPE .
With best regards,
SEBASTIEN COLLET
Siemens SAS

78140 Velizy-Villacoublay, France

additional_info.subject: Global ISP Backlog Cleanup initiative - Help Us Update Your ISP Ticket Status CRM:00362000092
additional_info.body:
Dear Ramdane,
I hope this email finds you well!
As part of our Customer Service team's global initiative to clean up our ticketing backlog, we're reaching out to help streamline our open cases.
During a recent review of our ISP ticketing system, we noticed several aging tickets that need a quick status check. We're here to help make this process as smooth as possible for you.
Would you be able to help us confirm:
If the repair/resolution has been completed
Whether any follow-up actions are still pending
Any relevant comments about the current situation
Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
